notes:
A page you have withdrawn from search will not be told it cannot be quoted.

busuu.com was told, at HIGH, that two pages are invisible to AI crawlers and
"can never be quoted or cited". One of the two carries
<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow"> — and the same report said so,
separately, under "1 page is blocked from indexing". One document called a page
deliberately withdrawn and then called that a defect worth fixing first.

The AI-rendering check looked at every page that answered, while the four other
checks beside it look at indexable pages only. It now looks at the same set they
do, and so does its twin in the content lane, which had the identical line and
the same problem. Where a noindex page genuinely matters — the analytics tag,
the site's fonts and colours — nothing changed.

Also carries the corrections from 1.3.56's cycle: five pieces of prose that
claimed the licence gate is inert in shipped builds. It is not.
